chapter.title: Overview
chapter.para: gsword is a C/GObject implementation of the SWORD module library. It is organized around a module library manager, immutable module metadata, and lazily opened module readers.

sect1.title: Basic usage
sect1.para: Open a module library, look up a module, set a key, and read text. The library owns the returned module and metadata objects; only values that are explicitly annotated as (transfer full) must be freed by the caller.
Module storage is opened lazily. Looking up metadata does not read the module data files; the backend is opened the first time that a key or entry is accessed.

sect1.title: Installing modules
sect1.para: GswInstallManager reads InstallMgr.conf, refreshes remote sources, reports progress through GswStatusReporter, and installs modules atomically. Synchronous and GTask-based asynchronous APIs are available.
Connect to the pre-status signal for status messages and to progress for byte-level progress:
The asynchronous variants use the standard GIO pattern: call gsw_install_manager_install_module_async() and then call gsw_install_manager_install_module_finish() from the GAsyncReadyCallback.

sect1.title: Keys and versification
sect1.para: GswModule exposes a module-compatible key through gsw_module_create_key(). Bible modules use GswVerseKey, dictionaries use GswStrKey, and general books use GswTreeKey. Verse keys can also be detached from a module and used with a versification system directly.
GswVersificationMgr provides the built-in KJV, Catholic, and other versification systems. Book names are localized through GswLocaleMgr.

sect1.title: Memory and ownership
sect1.para: GObject-based types are reference counted and released with g_object_unref(). Boxed key, versification, and directory-entry types use their own gsw_*_ref() and gsw_*_unref() functions. Functions returning arrays document their transfer mode; in particular, caller-owned arrays returned with (transfer full) must be freed with g_strfreev() or g_ptr_array_unref() as appropriate.

sect1.title: Supported drivers
sect1.para: Readers are provided for RawText, zText, RawCom, zCom, RawLD, zLD, RawGenBook, RawFiles, and HREFCom. Compression support includes LZSS, zlib, bzip2, and xz. Encrypted modules use SWORD-compatible Sapphire decryption.

sect1.title: Searching
sect1.para: gsw_module_search() provides phrase, multiword, and regular-expression searches over a module and returns matching key texts.

sect1.title: GObject Introspection
sect1.para: Configure with -Dintrospection=true to generate Gsw-0.1.gir and Gsw-0.1.typelib for Python, JavaScript, and other GObject binding consumers.

sect1.title: Building this reference
sect1.para: The API reference is generated from the public headers with gtk-doc:
sect1.programlisting: meson setup build-doc -Dgtk_doc=true meson compile -C build-doc docs
sect1.para: The generated HTML is written to build-doc/docs/reference/html/index.html and can be installed with meson install -C build-doc.
